description: R08 Host ApiRoutines tail checkpoint: safe Rust closes the seven remaining Microsoft ApiRoutinesTests contracts across console title reads, stateful A/W writes and ScrollConsoleScreenBufferW. The ApiRoutinesTests.cpp family is now complete with 16/16 Exact contracts.

entries.notes: ConsoleTitleState owns title storage plus ANSI-buffer null termination and written/needed counts for Microsoft's active ASCII title vector.
Wide title reads preserve UTF-16 content and the native W API count convention where written/needed exclude the terminator.
Original-title reads own native buffer/count semantics while the output-codepage transform remains an injected adapter; the Microsoft ASCII source vector is reproduced exactly.
Original UTF-16 title content, null termination and written/needed counts match the native W contract.
ConsoleWriter reproduces success/wait and consumed-byte observables across CP437, CP932 and UTF-8, retaining incomplete multibyte sequences across the native 0/1/2-byte chunk matrix.
Wide writes reproduce success/wait behavior and consumed UTF-16-unit counts while retaining written output in the portable owner.

ConsoleScreenBuffer performs snapshot-based source moves over terminal-buffer::TextBuffer with clipping, overlap, off-screen destinations, default null fill and explicit independence from VT margins across Microsoft's full parameter matrix.
